name: BRANDME_MODE
notes: Required; no default anywhere (config.py:134, config/index.ts:72). Single mode source; ENVIRONMENT must equal it (config.py:154-159).

name: ENVIRONMENT
default_in_code: yes (value is non-secret: chain zod default 'development' at brandme-chain/src/config/index.ts:15; Python processes have no default)
notes: Two semantics: brandme-chain uses ENVIRONMENT as its only mode (default development); Python processes accept it only as an echo of BRANDME_MODE. brandme-gateway/.env.example:11 says the gateway ignores it.

name: NODE_ENV
notes: Framework variable; set to production in the three Node images.

name: PORT
default_in_code: yes (value is non-secret: gateway 3001, chain 3001, read/export API 8000, consumer-domains 8010)
notes: Gateway and chain both default to 3001; gateway's CHAIN_SERVICE_URL default is :3003 (see CHAIN_SERVICE_URL).

name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER
notes: 'dev' is a labelled simulated sign-in refused in sandbox/production (middleware/mode.ts:53).

name: OIDC_AUDIENCE
notes: REPLACE_ME in sandbox values.
